podcast.body: A prominent track from the "In Your Honor" album, "Best of You" was a song that Dave Grohl initially resisted putting on the record. He was eventually convinced of its merit and importance by others. "Dave didn't really want that song on the record, but he was ultimately convinced that it might be the right thing to do."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song was included in a Spotify playlist assembled by Queen Mary University in London, featuring 700 songs most likely to evoke chills or goosebumps. The study found that sadder, slower, less intense, and more instrumental songs were generally the most effective in generating this physical reaction. "the Foo Fighters and Best of You."
